verdict.rationale: The Cactus Engine README states it exposes "OpenAI-compatible APIs for text, speech, and vision," which is the product's own documented vision capability. That is a single thin line, though, and nothing describes which vision-language models are supported or how image-plus-text input works. The generic, experimental HF conversion path is not vision-specific and adds no credit. Missing for 10: named supported VLMs, documentation of image+text input usage, examples or benchmarks, independent hands-on corroboration of image understanding.
